# googledrive

## Overview

googledrive allows you to interact with files on Google Drive from R.

## Installation

Install the CRAN version:

``` r

install.packages("googledrive")
```

Or install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("tidyverse/googledrive")
```

## Usage

Here’s a teaser that uses googledrive to view some of the files you see
on <https://drive.google.com> (up to `n_max = 25`, in this case):

``` r

library("googledrive")
drive_find(n_max = 25)
#> # A dribble: 16 × 3
#>    name                id       drive_resource   
#>    <chr>               <drv_id> <list>           
#>  1 chicken_sheet       1s0kEHc… <named list [38]>
#>  2 r_logo.jpg          1wFAZdm… <named list [46]>
#>  3 THANKS              19URV7B… <named list [45]>
#>  4 googledrive-NEWS.md 1h1lhFf… <named list [44]>
#>  5 def                 1ALSW_N… <named list [36]>
#>  6 abc                 1o89YN5… <named list [36]>
#>  7 BioC_mirrors.csv    13tMFbh… <named list [44]>
#>  8 Rlogo.svg           1lCQGxj… <named list [46]>
#>  9 DESCRIPTION         1KKYhtc… <named list [45]>
#> 10 r_about.html        1mHtQhv… <named list [45]>
#> 11 imdb_latin1.csv     1S5HxY7… <named list [44]>
#> 12 chicken.txt         1xMvlJH… <named list [45]>
#> 13 chicken.pdf         1au0aK6… <named list [45]>
#> 14 chicken.jpg         1-BF1c4… <named list [46]>
#> 15 chicken.csv         12212CX… <named list [44]>
#> 16 chicken_doc         11GY4Q4… <named list [38]>
```

## Where to learn more

[Get
started](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/articles/googledrive.html) is
a more extensive general introduction to googledrive.

Browse the [articles
index](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/articles/index.html) to find
articles that cover various topics in more depth.

See the [function
index](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/reference/index.html) for an
organized, exhaustive listing.

## Contributing

If you’d like to contribute to the development of googledrive, please
read [these
guidelines](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/CONTRIBUTING.html).

Please note that the googledrive project is released with a [Contributor
Code of
Conduct](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

## Privacy

[Privacy policy](https://tidyverse.org/google_privacy_policy/)

# Package index

## Reach out and touch your files

Retrieve metadata on your Drive files so you can act on them

- [`drive_find()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_find.md)
  : Find files on Google Drive
- [`drive_ls()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_ls.md)
  : List contents of a folder or shared drive
- [`drive_get()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_get.md)
  : Get Drive files by path or id
- [`drive_reveal()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_reveal.md)
  : Add a new column of Drive file information
- [`drive_browse()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_browse.md)
  : Visit Drive file in browser
- [`drive_read_string()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_read_string.md)
  [`drive_read_raw()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_read_string.md)
  : Read the content of a Drive file

## File creation and deletion

Create or delete Drive files and folders

- [`drive_upload()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_upload.md)
  : Upload into a new Drive file
- [`drive_put()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_put.md)
  : PUT new media into a Drive file
- [`drive_download()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_download.md)
  : Download a Drive file
- [`drive_create()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_create.md)
  : Create a new blank Drive file
- [`drive_mkdir()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_mkdir.md)
  : Create a Drive folder
- [`drive_cp()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_cp.md)
  : Copy a Drive file
- [`drive_mv()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_mv.md)
  : Move a Drive file
- [`drive_rename()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_rename.md)
  : Rename a Drive file
- [`drive_update()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_update.md)
  : Update an existing Drive file
- [`drive_trash()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_trash.md)
  [`drive_untrash()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_trash.md)
  : Move Drive files to or from trash
- [`drive_empty_trash()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_empty_trash.md)
  : Empty Drive Trash
- [`drive_rm()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_rm.md)
  : Delete files from Drive
- [`drive_examples_local()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_examples.md)
  [`drive_examples_remote()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_examples.md)
  [`drive_example_local()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_examples.md)
  [`drive_example_remote()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_examples.md)
  : Example files

## Share your files with the world

View or change the sharing and publishing status of Drive files

- [`drive_publish()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_publish.md)
  [`drive_unpublish()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_publish.md)
  : Publish native Google files
- [`drive_share()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_share.md)
  [`drive_share_anyone()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_share.md)
  : Share Drive files
- [`drive_reveal()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_reveal.md)
  : Add a new column of Drive file information
- [`drive_link()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_link.md)
  : Retrieve Drive file links

## Shared drives

Manipulate and explore shared drives

- [`as_shared_drive()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/as_shared_drive.md)

  [`no_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`single_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`some_files()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_dribble()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_single_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_some_files()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_folder()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_shortcut()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)

  [`is_mine()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_shared_drive()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  : Check facts about a dribble
- [`shared_drive_create()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drive_create.md)
  : Create a new shared drive
- [`shared_drive_find()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drive_find.md)
  : Find shared drives
- [`shared_drive_get()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drive_get.md)
  : Get shared drives by name or id
- [`shared_drive_rm()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drive_rm.md)
  : Delete shared drives
- [`shared_drive_update()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drive_update.md)
  : Update a shared drive
- [`shared_drives`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/shared_drives.md)
  : Access shared drives

## Dribble object

Metadata about Drive files is stored in a “Drive tibble” a.k.a. a
dribble

- [`dribble`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble.md)
  : dribble object

- [`as_dribble()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/as_dribble.md)
  :

  Coerce to a `dribble`

- [`drive_reveal()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_reveal.md)
  : Add a new column of Drive file information

- [`as_id()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_id.md)
  :

  `drive_id` class

- [`is_dribble()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`no_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`single_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`some_files()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_dribble()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_single_file()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`confirm_some_files()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_folder()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_shortcut()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_folder_shortcut()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_native()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_parental()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_mine()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  [`is_shared_drive()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/dribble-checks.md)
  : Check facts about a dribble

## Authorization

Take explicit control of the Google auth status or examine current state

- [`drive_user()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_user.md)
  : Get info on current user
- [`drive_about()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_about.md)
  : Get info on Drive capabilities
- [`drive_auth()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth.md)
  : Authorize googledrive
- [`drive_deauth()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_deauth.md)
  : Suspend authorization
- [`drive_auth_configure()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  [`drive_api_key()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  [`drive_oauth_client()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  : Edit and view auth configuration
- [`drive_scopes()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_scopes.md)
  : Produce scopes specific to the Drive API
- [`drive_token_write()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_token_write.md)
  [`drive_token_read()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_token_write.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Write/read a googledrive user token

## Drive API spec

Summon info about or check input against the Drive API spec

- [`drive_endpoints()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_endpoints.md)
  [`drive_endpoint()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_endpoints.md)
  : List Drive endpoints
- [`drive_extension()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_extension.md)
  : Lookup extension from MIME type
- [`drive_fields()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_fields.md)
  [`prep_fields()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_fields.md)
  : Request partial resources
- [`drive_mime_type()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_mime_type.md)
  : Lookup MIME type
- [`expose()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/expose.md)
  : An expose object

## Programming around the Drive API

Low-level functions used internally and made available for programming

- [`request_generate()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/request_generate.md)
  : Build a request for the Google Drive API
- [`request_make()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/request_make.md)
  [`do_request()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/request_make.md)
  [`do_paginated_request()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/request_make.md)
  : Make a request for the Google Drive v3 API
- [`drive_auth_configure()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  [`drive_api_key()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  [`drive_oauth_client()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_auth_configure.md)
  : Edit and view auth configuration
- [`drive_token()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_token.md)
  : Produce configured token
- [`drive_has_token()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/drive_has_token.md)
  : Is there a token on hand?

## Package-level configuration

- [`local_drive_quiet()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/googledrive-configuration.md)
  [`with_drive_quiet()`](https://googledrive.tidyverse.org/dev/reference/googledrive-configuration.md)
  : googledrive configuration
